name: Kagaribi
source:
You awaken in a dark, atmospheric void. Before you burns a mysterious bonfire (Kagaribi). Three spirits stand guard, bound by tragic memories and eternal regret.

Guided by haunting vocals and cryptic visions, you must navigate a labyrinth of the past. Why are you here? What did you forget? And what lies in the "Abyss"?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4323550/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你在黑暗、大气的虚空中醒来。在你燃烧神秘的篝火（Kagaribi）之前。三个灵魂守护着，被悲惨的记忆和永恒的遗憾所束缚。

在令人难以忘怀的声音和神秘幻象的引导下，你必须穿越过去的迷宫。你为什么在这里？你忘记了什么？而“深渊”里到底藏着什么呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4323550/]Steam[/url]]
